meta.name: comprehensive-soap-note
meta.description: Generate complete medical SOAP notes with all four sections in a single comprehensive file write operation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键生成完整的医疗SOAP病历
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在临床工作中快速生成结构化病历记录
copy.tagline_en: Generate complete medical SOAP notes with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create structured medical records in clinical practice

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会一次性生成完整的SOAP笔记（主观、客观、评估、计划四部分），并写入文件。
howto.when: 当你要求创建医疗就诊记录、患者就诊笔记、临床会诊记录或医疗随访记录时触发。

say.text: 为患者李四生成今天的SOAP笔记
say.note: 创建包含四部分的完整笔记。

say.text: 写一份关于糖尿病随访的SOAP记录
say.note: 会要求提供患者信息和临床数据。

say.text: 根据这次门诊记录创建SOAP笔记
say.note: 需提供主诉和检查结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate a complete SOAP note (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) and write it to a file in one operation.
howto.when_en: When you ask to create medical visit documentation, patient encounter records, clinical meeting notes, or healthcare follow-up documentation.

say_en.text: Generate a SOAP note for patient John Doe.
say_en.note: Creates a complete note with all four sections.

say_en.text: Write a SOAP record for diabetes follow-up.
say_en.note: Will ask for patient details and clinical data.

say_en.text: Create a SOAP note based on this clinic visit.
say_en.note: Provide chief complaint and exam findings.
